objective: Enter Shadowfang Keep solo. Get both half-keys from the siblings, combine them, and use the key on the stable chest for the Horn of Xelthos. Return it to the Dead Drop outside Pyrewood Village.

name: Goblin Lockpicks
objective: With The Horn of Xelthos active, pickpocket a Venture Co. Work Order from a Venture Co. goblin in Windshear Crag and trade it to Veenix for a Breaching Charge.
notes: The quest record specifies a minimum of 1. The heist takes place in the level-23 Shadowfang Keep chain.

objective: After turning in the horn, check your mail for C’s letter and revisit the Dead Drop to collect the Pyrewood Signet Ring.
notes: The quest record specifies a minimum of 1. The heist takes place in the level-23 Shadowfang Keep chain.

name: The Eye of Bhossca

objective: Go solo. Pickpocket a Scryer’s Key in the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, use it to recover the Eye from the locked reliquary in the Library, and return to the Silverpine Dead Drop. Players report getting the letter at level 30.

name: The Eye of Bhossca
objective: After returning the eye, check your mail for C’s letter and open the Dead Drop again to collect the Ruby-Adorned Blade.

objective: Enter Zul’Farrak solo, recover the Talisman of Kazdor from the Spellbound War Chest, and bring it back to Fahrad.

objective: Take the recovered talisman downstairs to Zan Shivsproket in Ravenholdt Manor.

name: One Last Drop
objective: Deliver the Modified Talisman to Caius’s Dead Drop near Pyrewood Village.

name: Biding Our Time

name: Fool Me Twice
objective: Speak to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor about the Zul’Farrak job. Players report receiving his letter at level 45 after the two earlier heists and The Manor, Ravenholdt.

objective: Recover the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde in the Ruins of Alterac, then return to Myrokos.

objective: Loot an Empty Firewater Flask from the Winterfall furbolgs and use it to start the quest. Deliver it to Donova.

objective: Report Ranshalla’s findings to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

objective: Intercept a Winterfall Runner patrol on the road and recover its Winterfall Crate for Donova.

objective: Use Umi’s Mechanical Yeti to scare Legacki in Everlook, Sprinkle in Gadgetzan, and Quixxil in Marshal’s Refuge. Return to Umi.

objective: Bring the Crystal of Zin-Malor to a Remorseful Highborne spirit at Lake Kel’Theril (56.1, 44.4).

objective: Ask Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village what to do with the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor

objective: Defeat 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Den Watchers, and 8 Ursa. Report to Salfa just outside the Winterspring tunnel exit.

objective: Find the Damaged Crate at Jaron’s wrecked camp in southern Winterspring (59.0, 59.8).

objective: From the damaged crate, find Jaron’s Wagon farther east at 61.4, 60.7.

name: Enraged Wildkin
objective: Recover Jaron’s Supplies by the wagon and the Blue-feathered Amulet from an owlbeast. Take both to Jaron in Starfall Village.

name: Guardians of the Altar
objective: Escort Ranshalla to the altar, helping with the torches along the way. Report to Erelas in Rut’theran Village.

name: High Chief Winterfall
objective: Defeat High Chief Winterfall in Winterfall Village and report to Donova. Check the chief for the quest-starting log.

objective: Loot the Crudely-written Log from High Chief Winterfall. Use it to start the quest and take it to Donova.

name: Words of the High Chief
objective: Carry the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper at Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood (51.1, 81.8).

name: Enraged Wildkin
objective: Speak to Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village (52.1, 30.4).
notes: Optional introduction to Jaron’s quest series.

objective: Collect 4 Frostmaul Shards from the giants or shard deposits in Frostwhisper Gorge and return to Mau’ari in Everlook.

objective: Speak to Mau’ari again for her Cache. Keep it with you to collect E’ko from Winterspring creatures.

objective: Bring Mau’ari 3 Frostsaber E’ko from the cats of northern Winterspring.

objective: Bring Mau’ari 3 Winterfall E’ko from Winterfall furbolgs.

objective: Bring Mau’ari 3 Shardtooth E’ko from Shardtooth bears.

objective: Bring Mau’ari 3 Chillwind E’ko from Chillwind chimaeras.

objective: Bring Mau’ari 3 Frostmaul E’ko from Frostmaul Giants or Preservers.

objective: Bring Mau’ari 3 Wildkin E’ko from the owlbeasts in Winterspring.

name: Finkle Einhorn, At Your Service!

name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant

name: Leggings of Arcana
objective: Bring Malyfous a Pristine Hide of the Beast, 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings, 5 Arcanite Bars, 5 Frostwhisper’s Embalming Fluids, and 50 gold.

name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
objective: Bring Malyfous a Pristine Hide of the Beast, 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings, 5 Arcanite Bars, 5 Skins of Shadow, and 50 gold.

name: Hot Fiery Death

objective: With Blacksmithing 275, search the Human Remains by the lava below the Firebrand orc camp. Collect the Unfired Plate Gauntlets and visit Malyfous in Everlook.

objective: Bring Malyfous the Unfired Plate Gauntlets, 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essences of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies.

name: Lorax's Tale
objective: Listen to Lorax’s story at the edge of Darkwhisper Gorge.

name: The Matron Protectorate
objective: Bring Awbee’s Scale to Mazthoril in Winterspring. Stand on a cobalt rune with the scale to reach Haleh (54.5, 51.2).

name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objective: Speak with Haleh at Mazthoril to continue.

name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objective: Find Jeziba in Andorhal, Western Plaguelands (39.4, 66.8).

objective: Defeat 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa for Rivern. Unlocks as your Wintersaber Trainers reputation rises.

name: Sweet Serenity
objective: Kill the Crimson Hammersmith in Stratholme and return his apron to Lilith in Everlook.

name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
objective: Defeat Shadow Hunter Vosh’gajin in Lower Blackrock Spire and return her Snakestone to Kilram in Everlook.

name: Corruption
objective: Defeat the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and return the Insignia of the Black Guard to Seril in Everlook.

objective: Defeat 4 Frostmaul Giants and 4 Frostmaul Preservers for Rivern. Unlocks at higher Wintersaber Trainers reputation.

objective: Take the Fragment of the Dragon’s Eye from Stormwind to Haleh at Mazthoril in Winterspring.

objective: Defeat General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire and bring the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion to Haleh.

objective: Use Gorn’s torch at the entrance to High Chief Winterfall’s cave. Defeat Xandivious and bring the essence to Gorn. Requires Exalted reputation.

objective: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge. Requires Exalted reputation.

objective: Speak with Elder Brightspear near Lake Kel’Theril during the Lunar Festival.

notes: Current data confirms the reputation eligibility and material requirements. Forever reputation reward amount is unverified.

name: Halt the Hail
objective: Defeat Hailspite in the hills south of Everlook and bring Hailspite Frostmoss to Umaron.

name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds
